entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'm calling because I need to return a pair of cycling shoes I purchased recently.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your order number, please?

Thank you. I see the order here. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault with something like the cleats, or more of a preference issue?

It's a matter of fit and comfort. I've used them a couple of times, but they're causing some pretty bad blisters on my heels. They just don't seem to be the right shape for my feet, so I'd like to get a refund.

I'm very sorry to hear the cycling shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the policy for you. Okay, I see your order was delivered 18 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve that return for you.

That's great news, thank you for making that straightforward. Now, since I'll be sending these back and will need to find another pair, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I'm still a VeloFit customer, just need a different model.

I appreciate you asking, and I understand you're looking for the best value. Our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on top of a return, but I can confirm you will be receiving a full refund for the item once it's processed at our warehouse. I've just emailed a pre-paid shipping label to you.
Okay, a full refund is the main thing. It was worth a shot. Thank you for your help processing this, Sarah.
You're very welcome. The instructions are in the email with the label. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
